title: coinscope
tagline: Real-time onchain token prices, completely decentalized with RPC events
description: CoinScope is a comprehensive real-time cryptocurrency price discovery platform that aggregates token prices across multiple decentralized exchanges (DEXes) and delivers live price feeds through WebSocket connections. Built with modern web technologies and blockchain infrastructure, it provides institutional-grade price data for DeFi tokens with sub-second latency.
how_its_made:
Backend Infrastructure
Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects: Serverless architecture with persistent state management
TypeScript: Type-safe development with comprehensive error handling
Ethers.js: Direct blockchain interaction for on-chain price calculations
WebSocket Architecture: Real-time bidirectional communication with clients
Data Sources & Integrations
Moralis API: Primary pool discovery and metadata aggregation
BlockScount for logos, 1inch for price history
Direct DEX Queries: Fallback system querying factory contracts directly
Multi-DEX Support: Uniswap V2/V3, SushiSwap, PancakeSwap V2/V3
On-Chain Price Calculation: Real-time price computation from pool reserves
